name: io.github.tonyyang0504/google-mcp
description: Google Ads (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report, pause_resume. Every tool maps to a

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: OAuth 2.0 client id (Google Cloud console > Credentials) of the app that the Google Ads user authorised with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/adwords.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The OAuth client's secret; sent in the form body of the refresh_token grant.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token obtained once through Google's consent flow (offline access, scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/adwords); the runtime mints hourly access tokens from it.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Google Ads API developer token (manager account > Admin > API Center), sent as the `developer-token` header on every call; Test-access tokens only work against test accounts.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_CUSTOMER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Google Ads customer id (10 digits, no dashes) of the account being managed: pause_resume mutates campaigns under it, and list_accounts reads its customer_client hierarchy (itself plus direct clients when it is a manager). When the user reaches it through a manager account, also set login_customer_id.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Manager customer id (digits, no dashes) sent as `login-customer-id` when the user reaches client accounts through a manager account; leave unset for direct access.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = production host with test accounts or test keys. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_GOOGLE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.
